integrity: Analytic killed-generator, renewal-occupation and flux proofs; deterministic quadrature consistency checks only; no claim of independent scientific certification.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional free Brownian exploration, independent finite-mean exploration clocks, same-diffusivity OU first-hit return. Explicit tail asymptotics are for a Pareto survival clock; no finite-time bounds, multidimensional model or independent priority validation. The harmonic energy identity is established prior work.
title: Two exact spatial tail exponents for Pareto-driven harmonic first-hit returns
